patterns.example: The System shall resolve the engine only from a plugin-owned location.

patterns.rule: response to a triggering event, keyword When
patterns.example: When a self-update verb is issued against the pinned CLI, the System shall refuse it.

patterns.rule: active while a state holds, keyword While
patterns.example: While the mutation policy is deny, the System shall refuse raw git mutations.

patterns.rule: response to an undesired condition, keywords If and Then
patterns.example: If the vendored binary is missing, then the System shall refuse rather than fall back.

patterns.rule: applies when a feature is included, keyword Where
patterns.example: Where the repository declares a docs branch, the System shall keep it rebased.

complex.example: While the mutation policy is warn, when a raw git mutation is requested, the System shall perform it and journal it.
While a feature is open, if its branch is deleted, then the System shall mark the feature orphaned.
Where commitlint is enabled, when a commit message fails a rule, the System shall reject the commit.

banned_terms.description: Words that make a requirement untestable. A statement containing any of these fails validation regardless of shape.
